address: Embalse de La Jarosa, Guadarrama, 28440, Spain
bio: This attractive family-run restaurant in the heart of nature and just a stone's throw from the La Jarosa reservoir is the perfect setting in which to re-energise close to Madrid. Grilled meat and rice dishes are the mainstays on the à la carte, although you’ll also find an impressive selection of tapas and several Japanese-inspired dishes. The rustic-minimalist interior comes as a pleasant surprise, as does the charming chillout terrace....
